sentences.japanese: 彼らのコミュニケーションは我々が考えてきたものよりはるかに複雑かもしれません。
sentences.english: Their communication may be much more complex than we thought.
I don't think, therefore I am not.

sentences.japanese: 我々は友人のことを考えねばなりません。
我々は最悪の事態を考えておかなければいけない。
sentences.english: We have to expect the worst.

sentences.japanese: 我々は彼をすぐに病院へ連れていかねばならない。彼は重症だ。
sentences.english: We have to take him to the hospital immediately; he is seriously injured!
